product.description: Stage Right™ by Monoprice™5‑Watt 1x8 Guitar Combo Tube Amp with Celestion® SpeakerWorld's best reviewed and and most affordable 5‑watt 1x8 all‑tube guitar ampThe Stage Right™ 5‑Watt 1x8 Guitar Combo Tube Amp delivers the same rich, dynamic tone that has made Stage Right amps a favorite among guitarists—now in a smaller, more accessible format. Similar in design to the highly praised 15‑watt model, this compact amp features a single 6V6GT power tube and a Celestion® Super 8 speaker, offering the warmth, clarity, and responsiveness of amps that cost several times more.Whether you're practicing at home, recording in the studio, or looking for a portable tube amp with serious tone, the 5‑Watt Combo brings professional sound and vintage character in a budget-friendly package.All-tube design, driven by one 6V6GT and one 12AX7 tubesFeatures a Celestion® Super 8 8" speaker5 watts of output power, ideal for practice and recordingMinimal design, with volume and tone controls {C}REVIEWERS' TOP CHOICESince its launch, the Monoprice™ Stage Right™ 5‑Watt 1x8 Guitar Combo Tube Amp made an impact in the guitar community, earning exceptional reviews from credible players all over the world. Described as "mind blowingly good", "best bang for buck", or simply "amazing", players continue to validate the amp's claims of tone and affordability. This 5‑watt amp uses a similar design its mega‑popular 15‑watt larger brother, but using a single 6V6GT tube for the power section and a Celestion® Super 8 speaker driver. {C}ALL‑TUBE DESIGNLike the proven and iconic American guitar amps of the 50s and 60s, the Monoprice™ Stage Right™ 5‑Watt 1x8 Guitar Combo Tube Amp delivers classic all‑tube guitar tone rivaling that of any small amp, period. Known as the "little brothers" of the more powerful 6L6 tubes, 6V6 tubes break up a little easier to deliver classic overdrive at lower volume levels. {C}CELESTION LOADEDLike the popular 1x12 version, the Monoprice™ Stage Right™ 5‑Watt 1x8 Guitar Combo Tube Amp features a Celestion® Super 8, which is a popular 8" speaker driver that delivers balanced tone that is perfectly matched with the 5‑watt amp. .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
